templates.title: Traefik
templates.name: traefik
templates.description: Reverse proxy shared by all Adipsys products. Install it first.
templates.note: Install this template before any Adipsys product. It creates the traefik_default network.

env.name: TRAEFIK_VERSION
env.label: Traefik version
env.description: Image tag (traefik:<version>).

templates.title: Hotspot Manager
templates.name: hotspotmanager
templates.description: ⚠️ Install the Traefik template first. Create captive portals compliant with Wi-Fi legislation and collect data.
templates.note: Adipsys HotspotManager: please read documentation on http://docs.adipsys.com. You can open a ticket at https://support.adipsys.com. Requires the Traefik stack.

env.name: PRODUCT_VERSION
env.label: Release
env.description: Product version. Change it in the stack to update.

env.name: OPERATOR
env.label: Operator*
env.description: Your company name (no spaces nor special characters).

env.name: HM_SERVER_NAME
env.label: Server name*
env.description: Hostname used with the domain to build all the server URLs.

env.name: HM_URL_SUFFIX
env.label: Domain*
env.description: i.e. adipsys.com

env.name: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
env.label: MySQL root password*
env.description: Please keep the password for further use.

templates.title: DNS Protect
templates.name: dnsprotect
templates.description: ⚠️ Install the Traefik template first. Secure Wi-Fi connections: protect users by filtering malicious/illegal contents.
templates.note: Adipsys DNSprotect: please read documentation on http://docs.adipsys.com. You can open a ticket at https://support.adipsys.com. Requires the Traefik stack.

env.name: PRODUCT_VERSION
env.label: Release
env.description: Product version. Change it in the stack to update.

env.name: SERVER_NAME
env.label: Server URL*
env.description: URL of the admin interface (must also be set in your DNS).

env.name: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
env.label: MySQL root password*
env.description: Please keep the password for further use.

env.name: ADMIN_PASSWD
env.label: Admin interface password*
env.description: Account: admin.

env.name: DNS_PORT
env.label: DNS server port (UDP)
env.description: Changing it is not advised.

templates.title: STUDIO
templates.name: studio
templates.description: ⚠️ Install the Traefik template first. Create and broadcast targeted advertising and informational contents before and/or after the captive portal.
templates.note: Adipsys STUDIO: please read documentation on http://docs.adipsys.com. You can open a ticket at https://support.adipsys.com. Requires the Traefik stack.

env.name: PRODUCT_VERSION
env.label: Release
env.description: Product version. Change it in the stack to update.

env.name: OPERATOR
env.label: Operator*
env.description: Your company name (no spaces nor special characters).

env.name: STUDIO_NAME
env.label: Server URL*
env.description: URL of the server (must also be set in your DNS).

env.name: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
env.label: MySQL root password*
env.description: Please keep the password for further use.

templates.title: Hotspot Manager HA
templates.name: hotspotmanager-ha
templates.description: ⚠️ Install the Traefik template first. High availability setup on a 3-manager Swarm cluster (advanced users only).
templates.note: Adipsys HotspotManager HA: please read documentation on http://docs.adipsys.com. You can open a ticket at https://support.adipsys.com. Requires a 3-manager Swarm cluster and the Traefik stack.

env.name: PRODUCT_VERSION
env.label: Release
env.description: Product version. Change it in the stack to update.

env.name: OPERATOR
env.label: Operator*
env.description: Your company name (no spaces nor special characters).

env.name: HM_SERVER_NAME
env.label: Server name*
env.description: Hostname used with the domain to build all the server URLs.

env.name: HM_URL_SUFFIX
env.label: Domain*
env.description: i.e. adipsys.com

env.name: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
env.label: MySQL root password*
env.description: Please keep the password for further use.

env.name: HA_PRIMARY_NODE
env.label: Primary node hostname*
env.description: Hostname of the primary node (see docker node ls). It runs the DB seed, the admin web and rsyslog.

env.name: HA_DB_REPLICAS
env.label: Galera secondary nodes
env.description: Keep 1 for the initial bootstrap (seed + 1 node). Once the cluster is synced, set it to 2 in the stack and update it to add the 3rd node.

templates.title: UP agent
templates.name: up-agent
templates.description: Inventory agent: sends a technical report (OS, ISO, Docker, Swarm, Portainer, Adipsys products and versions) to the Adipsys support console every 6 hours.
templates.note: Read-only, no open port. One agent per node (global service). Requires outbound HTTPS to up-console.adipsys.net (directly or through a proxy). The enrollment token is provided by Adipsys.

env.name: PRODUCT_VERSION
env.label: Release
env.description: Agent version. Change it in the stack to update.

env.name: UP_ENROLL_TOKEN
env.label: Enrollment token*
env.description: Provided by Adipsys support.

env.name: UP_CUSTOMER_HINT
env.label: Operator name
env.description: Optional, helps the support identify this server.

env.name: HTTPS_PROXY
env.label: Outbound proxy
env.description: Optional, e.g. http://proxy:3128 (leave empty for direct access).
